name: QwenPaw
description: Self-hosted personal AI assistant from the AgentScope team that works across chat apps and is extended with skills and plugins.
whatItDoes: QwenPaw handles scheduled jobs such as digests and reports, coding help, file work and everyday questions, reachable from a web console and multiple messaging channels. It runs on your own machine or in the cloud.
howItWorks: A locally run service built on AgentScope keeps memory, runs skills and tools, schedules recurring tasks and bridges to chat platforms. Models, including local ones via Ollama or LM Studio, are configured in settings.

requirements.name: Model provider
requirements.description: e.g. DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, or a local model server

requirements.name: Python
requirements.description: pip install; Docker image also published

models: Qwen via DashScope, other cloud providers, local models
